reviewText: Great food and beer. Great service. Enough for me.
Very taste burgers, lots of options. The line its generally out the door but they have great line management. Restaurant never feels packet, they keep you entertained during the wait.
Excellent burgers with a vast selection of different types. Great fries. Only downside is that there is always a long line!

Hopdoddy is phenomenal! They have a pretty inexpensive repoire of burgers that taste absolutely salubrious. I left there, completely full with a burger and fries and only spent around 8 bucks. The down side is you might have to wait a ridiculously long time.
Burgers are wonderful, hate the line though.

I tend to avoid this location for the simple fact that finding parking most any day or time is next to impossible on South Congress aka SoCo (there is a parking garage, but I have never been able to find a space here) so by the time you have found a spot that isn't in on Ben White, you are hangry and frazzled only to be greeted by epically long lines. I have only braved this location a handful of times out of sheer cravings and stubborness, but will usually go to the Anderson location and brave the lines there without as much of a parking sitch headache.  That being said, I do love me some Hopdoddy and my craving for an Ahi-Tuna Burger and fries with chipotle ketchup somehow prevails.  The food here in general is just outright delicious! The Ahi burger is my handsdown favorite and the fries here are amazeballs as well with the equally delish chipotle ketchup, you can't go wrong! They seem to have a wider beer selection here than the Anderson location and the goblet'o'beer is always FTW.   As with the Anderson location, the only other thing about Hopdoddy that puzzles me is the weird seating set up...so you stand in line and order at the counter cafeteria style, but while in line a person will come up to you and give you a table number based on the number in your party on a piece of paper that you give to the order taker at said counter with some vague directions as to where you table is located. Sometimes you don't get a table number until the last possible minute, but somehow they always manage to seat your party. Everything is self-serve going through the line, but your food is brought out to you and you inexplicably have a "server" that will check on your table periodically to bring you refills or whatever you may be in need of. This setup just doesn't make a lot of sense to me as they should either be a cafeteria self-serve setup or a sitdown restaurant setup; so, for me, the odd hybrid setup took some getting used to. But, for burgers this good, you learn to adapt!
There is usually a long line but it's definitely worth the wait! I've had a different burger every time and I've loved all of them!
In love with the Nutella pretzel shake! Seriously one of the best ever. My favorite burger in Austin.

Hopdoddy has the best burgers in town! There is always a long line, but it moves quickly so you never have to wait a long time. Great place to go for dinner and walk around up and down south Congress.

Burger was excellent. I had the spicy burger, cannot remember the name, but it was pretty good. So were the two Classic Burgers..You could taste the freshness. THe chocolate milkshake was also pretty awesome. What was sort of horrible was the wait, cos we had to stand in line outside for 20 mins in the heat. They were nice about servicing water though to customers
Love the burgers at Hopdoddy!  Can be a long wait, but it moves fast and is very well-organized.  Atmosphere is fun and good for people watching.

Everyone needs to hop on over to Hopdoddy, STAT!! So I first went to Hopdoddy about two years ago, at about the time when it first opened. I remember waiting in line for over an hour (the end of the line was still inside Hopdoddy so we figured it wouldn't take that long. Boy were we wrong). Even though the food was delicious, I couldn't justify waiting in line for that long ever again.   Recently, a friend and I were picking a place for dinner and she suggested Hopdoddy. It was peak dinner time on a Friday night and I was starving. I got queasy just thinking about the wait time, but I agreed to go. And after a great experience that time, and a few times after that, I'm so remorseful over all of the time that I avoided going to Hopdoddy. I could have enjoyed two years of delicious burgers. Now I must make up for lost time.  So yes, the lines are sometimes long, but Hopdoddy has gotten it down to a science. The line moves way faster than you think it will (even when you're waiting outside and it's wrapping around the building). I would say, on average, I've waited about 30 minutes (even during peak times) and it's completely bearable, especially if you grab a beer while you're waiting. On the topic of beer, they have a pretty good selection, but I've heard GREAT things about their cervezarita. Definitely trying that next time.  But really, it's all about the burgers. Sometimes I don't want to eat them because the bun is so perfect, but then I remind myself about how delicious they are and I can't stop. I've had quite a few from the menu and honestly, I can't complain about any of them, it really just depends on what you like. I am personally a huge fan of the Primetime, El Diablo, and the Magic Shroom. The Ahi Tuna and the Goodnight are really good too. Honestly, they all are. You won't be disappointed. Also, make sure you get the fries, mainly so you can dip it in/practically inhale their special honey mustard and chipotle ketchup, both of which are delicious.  Also, MILKSHAKES!! Get one. Any of them. I would recommend Caramel & Sea Salt  or Nutella & Chocolate Pretzel (I cheated during Lent when I gave up nutella just to have this, and it was so worth it). They are really big, so if you are with someone I recommend sharing.

HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE. We parked nearby in a place that had no non-parking or warning signs. The line was endless, so we smelled the burgers, but didn't eat them. Then we found one of our tires broken with a knife; whom would do that, especially to a car with a baby sit in the back?

It's almost not worth reviewing because everyone already knows this place is ridiculously good. You can tell by the 24 hour line out the door, it's like Franklin BBQ! Oy! But really their burgers are delicious and I'd definitely recommend the lamb burger (let them cook it med rare y'all, it won't kill you and you'll be thanking me), the truffle fries, and the green chile quesoooomg!! Also was very happy with their well-margarita. I can be kinda snobby about tequila too but this was great!
Get there early before lunch. My favorite is the Buffalo burger. Make sure to get extra blue cheese.
Great place to eat...long lines though go with pleanty of time and not too hungry!
The MOST FOODGASMIC burger place you could ever eat at!!!! Go for the Primetime! and their fries can never do you wrong! All local. All natural. GO TEXAN!
Amazing burgers.  Amazing fries.  Awesome soda selection.  Can't beat it.
Its a cool and unique spot to eat and enjoy lunch/dinner. The price is fair and the food is worth it. its also an oppurtunity to try new different burgers. The shakes are equally delicious
Burgers worth the long wait and you can get served beers as you wait in line that wraps around outside the building. Milkshakes are great too!

I refuse to wait in a "gimmick" line at any place. The food is great, however it's not "wait in line for an hour or two" great.  Your best bet is to go during the week for an early or late lunch since it's the off hours. And try to sit at the bar as there's always a seat open there.
Absolutely best
BEST BURGER JOINT IN TOWN
Great Burgers. Delicious Shakes and fries. Be willing to wait in long lines. The end result is totally worth it.
This place is great.  Get there early because it fills up fast during lunch.
The lines might be long but boy are the burgers worth it. Don't let the wait change your mind about this iconic Austin eatery!

Line is nuts, but probably the best burger I have ever eaten. The fries were amazing. Get the bison burger, perfect bun that's lightly toasted with tender meat cooked perfectly. Try to sit by the bar, since you don't have to wait in the line to order.
Best hamburgers! Try the magic shroom and their fabulous shakes!!!
Overrated. The burger was just ok. The fries were not very good. There are much better burger joints in town that do not have a ridiculous wait.
Even though the line is always around the door, the food is totally worth the wait. Favorite drink is the Greyhound!

The food is amazing. The burgers and the sides are all prepared fresh and are first class. They offer a selection of both exotic and organic meats served in a number of delicious ways. Do not skip the shakes or the bison burger or you will regret it.  This is a must for any visit to Austin.
Such a good burger. Just try to avoid the crowds.
Chic burger joint on soco, awesome fries!
Great place.
Best burger and drinks in town.  Such a great experience!

Maybe a little overpriced, in my opinion, but they know what they're doing around a burger.  A lot of options to choose from.  If you're coming for lunch, be prepared to stand in line if you show up after 12:30p.
Love love love this place! Amazing food, great drinks, and crazy atmosphere. It's definitely hoppin' so be ready for it to be busy - but it's so worth it!

I went to hopdoddys for the first time ever yesterday for lunch and I came away feeling like I had just eaten the best burger in my life. I highly reccomend you stopping by and giving it a chance whenever you're in Austin.
One of the first places i ate at in austin. Good food in a pretty cool location. Would be five stars if the wait weren't so long.

This is the best burger in Austin! I love it! Sometimes there's a long wait but it's worth it. I try to plan to go at times when I know they won't be busy, but I've also waited in line many times to enjoy these burgers because they are so good!
Really enjoy the food here.  It is worth the wait, even though sometimes you have to wait in line a long time.  There's nothing bad on the menu.  And the shakes are a must!

Amazing food at a great price.  Huge beers.  Don't worry about the line, there's a reason there's one.  Just load up a game of Angry Birds on your Iphone or something.  But omg, these burgers are GOOD!
Best burger I've ever tried. Very relaxed environment and friendly staff. I go there almost every week, so this place has to be excellent.   Primetime and buffalo bill are the best choices!!
Hopdoddy's burgers are probably the best in town! Their shakes are great as well. There is normally a line, but it always moves quickly. The chili cheese fries are a must if you go!
Awesome burgers!

Hopdoddy has awesome burgers and everything they use is from somewhere local. The burgers ranged from 8-12 dollars but they are worth it. If you go on your birthday, you can get a free float/shake from them if you show them your ID. The line is a little long during its rush hours but it is worth the wait.

One of the best burgers in town.  The burgers are not huge for $8 but they are high quality, and dripping with flavor and juice.  Great drinks, local beers, and love the Maine sodas on tap.  The service is top notch and even the inevitable lines are not that bad.

While I don't usually enjoy restaurants that make you learn a "system" to order there, our family really did enjoy the food.  We liked that you could order a beer while you were waiting to order but we didn't understand the "system" at first and had to go back to get them.  There were a ton of kids there so we wish they would add a kids menu but I guess that is easier for them and better for their bottom line.  The atmosphere suffered from the same as many new restaurants because it is all metal and glass and really loud, but we liked the choice of making the tables really tall.  Must add that the Llano Poblano was one of the best burgers I have ever had.

Really good food! Must go place in Austin! Make sure to leave enough time for lunch though, lines can be pretty long during the week! Must try an oreo milkshake! The Bison burger is the best. Fries are enough to share.
Lines are long as hell, but its well worth the wait. Bison burger is what is up.
Mr.Tony is awesome and is super nice to me when we go there. The sea salt and caramel milk shake is AMAZING!!!
Lines are always super long but sometimes is surprising at how fast it moves (kinda).  It's a great burger, ingredients are from local farmers which is very cool.

The reviews don't lie. It really is that good and worth the long wait.  I always get the diablo with goat cheese instead of pepper jack to cool out the heat of the habaneros a bit, but I've had everything and it's all good!!  Their homemade margs are hands down the best!!
Best burger in Austin.
I had the bison burger and it came out perfect along with the fries. The employees were very nice and provided great service. The food is a bit pricey though at $8-10 for a burger and ~$4 for fries.

Who would have thought that standing in line, peering through floor to ceiling windows, watching others eat what appear to be delicious burgers and fries, would be so fun?    Hopdoddy is putting out the best burger in Austin currently, the local craft beer selection is not expansive, but, of high quality (enjoyed in line or sitting down), and the staff is consistently upbeat and positive - a great combination.  For those who love a good cheeseburger, Hopdoddy sets the Austin baseline - it's a great bun made onsite, thick juicy patty, and a creatively satisfying, but not overwhelming, taste.  The burger can be, at times, too juicy, making the bottom half of your bun turn slightly soggy - yep, it's getting that particular.

Best part, one of the best burgers I've ever had... gourmet or not. Worst part, was the line. We waited outside in a line, just to be placed in the "inside" line. It was worth it though. Very tender beef, flavorful... and great taste combinations. Love the soda and beer selection, and the beer is served in chilled GOBLETS. Yes, like, as in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade Holy Grail goblets. Pretty epic. Def. a top 5 in Austin, and not just for burgers.

Hopdoddy has the best burgers in town.  There are a ton of awesome burger places in Austin, but I will always go to Hopdoddy first.  From the meat to the buns, everything is fantastic.  If you do go for lunch, try to get there before 11:30 because the place gets packed!
I love the burgers here. Best in town for overall burger joint experience. Come early though, they pretty much always have a 30 minute wait, but it's definitely worth the wait.

This is the "delux" burger place. Fresh buns, made in house have your mouth watering before you even have a chance to read the menu.  I've fallen head over heals for the mushroom burger and their milkshakes....to die (or diet) for!
The owner chuck has top notch service, phenomenal food, and a great atmosphere.

Every time I've gone to Hopdoddy it's been great. The hamburgers are amazing, and the milkshakes are even better. It's a very popular place so if you go during busy hours ,like dinner on a weekend, you might have to wait in line for a while. But it's always worth it.

Pretty good atmosphere. The line wrapped around the side of the building was kind of a bummer, but it was worth the wait. There's not really anything terrible on the menu, so have at it. The shakes were amazing as well!!!

Hopdoddy is my favorite place in Austin to go for a burger. The atmosphere is fantastic and their burgers are organic. There are so many delicious burger combinations!!! They have funny marketing too. The only thing is that it's really crowded all the time, so there are long lines.
We went here on a double date night and we loved it.  the food and atmosphere is amazing!  The greek burger is unusual and so tasty.  We love it and will bring our kids back!

This place is DELICIOUS!  They use high quality ingredients and it's probably the best burger I've ever had.  The smell of the bread baking is overwhelming.  Their bar menu is unique and they only feature local beers.  The way you order and receive your food is also out of the norm.  SO GOOD!
They have surprisingly good salads, and their veggie burger is better than most.
Really love the food here. I really recommend the Llano Poblano. One thing I can say is the wait takes a while, but it's worth it.

First burger I've had in Texas and I have to say, Hopdoddy's will be my new high standard for burgers. The fries were excellent, the service was excellent and my beer was served in a huge, chilled goblet. What's not to love? I look forward to going back soon, hopefully without the line. We got there just before the dinner rush and had no problem getting our food ordered and being seated, but when we walked out - the line was around the block. Go during non-peak hours for sure.
Try the Continental Club - the turkey burger is amazing

It's "simple, but they really get it right" at this SoCo burger bar turning out "juicy, flavorful" patties on freshly baked buns backed by "heavenly" floats and shakes made with house-churned ice creams (with spiked versions for the grown-ups); it's "always packed" with "crazy lines" for ordering at peak hours, though most find it worth the wait.

Not at all worth the hype. When I pay what I did for a burger, I expect that they would cook it the way I asked. I suppose I could have sent it back, but not one person asked me how my order was. Low level of service and it does not live up to the hype. Skip the line. Actually, just skip South Congress completely and check out the rest of what ATX has to offer.
The food is good but the wait is horrible. I also am not a fan of the fries.
Great burgers and great service....shakes are good too.
One of the best places in town to eat. THeir shakes are cray cray. The burgers are good - of course. I don't eat bread and I still leave happy.

I'm a pretty frugal person, but I have no qualms about paying $10+ on one of these insanely-delicious burgers! The Shroom burger is my favorite and has the perfect pairing of mushrooms and goat cheese, but even the plain burger is divine. I have a couple vegetarian friends, who tell me that the hemp burger is the best vegetarian burger they've ever had. Their drinks are also pretty great- I tend just to get the margarita, but my friends really like the margs that come with baby coronas in them- And they're served in giant goblets, which is hilarious to hold while you wait in line to order your food. Their fries are actually really good, and I'm not much of a fry person in general.   The line can get pretty long, especially on First Thursdays, but it tends to move pretty quickly- And it's SO worth it! My mouth is watering right now..
O.M.G. these burgers are amazing, its like a healthy burger. I could eat there everyday! Go early :)
Best burger in Austin.  Hate the line, love the food.
Really great burgers....make sure to have some chipotle ketchup!

One of the greatest disparities between line length and quality. The burgers are good, but jeez, go to P Terry's, Casino, or even (say it quietly) the Hideout for just as good of a burger.  Franklin's is the only place worthy of this kind of line.

Best burger I've ever had! I always feel so satisfied when I've finished a burger and fries here--the meat is AWESOME, and the buns are so tasty. Their sassy sauce, BBQ sauce, and homemade Chipotle Ketchup make the burgers even better. And the fries are some of the best I've had too! I took a friend here who also said the shakes were "legit." The seating arrangement is clever, too--I like how the staff finds you a table so you don't have to worry about it. I'd recommend going during off hours, though--it gets so packed at peak times!

The burger was pretty great. I had the Primtime burger. The service was great until we actually got a table. We were told we'd get a server and could order a milkshake before they closed at the table but they never came so uh well. The parmesan fries are a MUST!!!!! Best fries I've had with a burger. Highly recommened and good beer selection too.

I had the "Magic Mushroom" burger and it was the absolute best burger I've had in Texas so far!  A friend of mine works just south of Hopdoddy's every other week, and we found the restaurant at #8 on Urbanspoon.  She let me try her "Terlingua" burger, which was also delicious.  Our server brought the burgers out to us about five minutes after we ordered, and it was about $16 for two burgers, one basket of fries, and two drinks.  What a great deal for such an awesome lunch!  I'm so excited to have a place like Hopdoddy's here in town!

Gourmet burgers have been around for ages on the coasts, and now they're in Austin and Hop Doddy doesn't disappoint. The food just just a huge cut above. For those people who think places like Five Guys and In N Out have the best burgers they need to come to a place where the chefs know what they're doing and being creative, like this place. I wish they were a little more creative though. While the food is great, there's nothing that really screams "WOW!" at me, unlike some other gourmet burger places out west like Umami Burger that just blow my mind. Still, it's the best burger I've had yet in Austin.
Worth the long lines.
love the burgers here and its always a fun time. try the nutell shake.

I love hamburgers, they are my weakness. So that being said, Hopdoddy is the place I go to satisfy my hamburger craving, which happens often. This is the first place I always recommend to people when they want a good hamburger.My favorite is the Magic Shroom burger. Goat cheese. Enough said.

Pretty solid burgers (I've tried everything from the Primetime to the basic classic burger w/ bacon and have enjoyed them all), shakes, and fries.  Try the fries with the green chile queso and you won't regret it.  The wait can be a little obnoxious sometimes, at both locations, however it goes pretty fast, considering how long the lines can be.  I try to go during weekday evenings to minimize the wait.  Definitely worth it, but there still are other better burgers in Austin.

This is my favorite restaurant in Austin! They're definitely the best I've ever had, even better than In-N Out!! Went there with my friend Ethan, and he swears he's a changed man. The white chocolate raspberry milkshake is da bomb diggityyy.
I do consider myself a burger aficionado--or snob--and this one ranks with the best. Good beer and fries help.  Be prepared for a 20 min wait at meal times.
Awesome place, burgers are natural grass feed beef. Fries are also delicious, make sure to ask for the cheese sauce! Parking can be pretty bad and expect a little bit of a wait on saturdays.

The gourmet burgers are excellent. They are best in town if you are looking for gourmet burgers. They have a good decent beer selection. On weekend you may have to wait in line from 20-60 minutes but it is worth it.  The staff took drink orders while we were in line. They also brought us water while in line. Every visit to Hopdoddy has been great.  If we had an issue with the food the staff took care of it promptly.
Lines can be long depending on when you go. Their food is amazing and they have vegan options (Janie Joplin) and Gluten Free buns. People with eating restrictions welcome!

I try to have a different burger every time I go. And everytime I swear I have a new favorite on my last trip I had the tuna burger with wasabi and it really hit the spot. Try and go at weird times to avoid the crowds!

The enviornent and the feel of the restuarant very modern and welcoming. The staff is very happy to help and get you anything that you might need during your meal. If anything is wrong with the food, they are really good at correcting the order in a timely manner and not charging you any extra fees. I would recommend this retuarant to anyone seeking to eat excellent American food!

I've lived in Austin for fourteen years and in that time there has never been a amazing local burger joint. While I am a huge Mighty Fine fan, it was also a pain to go so far north for a burger. Now that i have hopdoddy, I can enjoy a high quality burger (with amazing French fries and chipotle ketchup) in the amazing atmosphere of south congress.

This place has some of the best burgers in Austin. For being so busy everything is well organized. The staff is so friendly. I had the magic shroom burger and it was by far the freshest tasting burger I've ever had. The fries with a side of chili cheese was the perfect addition to to meal. It's well worth the price!
The Goodnight is an amazing burger with the grilled onions and the jalopenos!! Best burgers in town!

I ate the Primetime Burger of Kobe beef. It was seriously amazing! My partner got the same thing and a chocolate pretzel,carmel, Godiva shake. That shake was ridiculously awesome. My partner also had socosweet tea and I had a coke and a Maker's Mark. Total price was $54.22 for burgers and drinks! That's really good deal for the quality of food. Without the drinks the burgers would have been around $12 each. Great food, great prices for location and food quality, really good service.  If you haven't eaten here before I highly recommend it.
Best gluten-free hamburger in town! Add in their awesome actual burgers and South Congress locale...winner!

Excellent burgers - the best in Austin! My favorite is the goodnight burger. The beer they have on tap is great too. There is almost always a line, but that's because EVERYONE wants to go here! Wait time is on average 20 - 30, but it's worth it! The only reason to not go here is if you are in a hurry.

Don't be intimidated by the line outside the restaurant, it actually goes by pretty quickly. They have water stations and umbrellas for when you're outside waiting and you can even order beer as you wait. Best burger I've had in a long time. Buffalo Bill is a must get
I love a good cheeseburger but never expected to find a line around the building waiting to get into a burger joint. These aren't your average burgers. You can taste the quality and freshness.

Amazing burgers. The signature sauces are superb. Just ate here for the first time last week and I believe it will become a regular stop for my girl and me. Service was great; I was impressed by the entire operation.
Amazing gourmet burgers and rich shakes. Can't really complain. Prices what you would expect for a gourmet burger. Try the Ahi Tuna burger, change your life.
Worth the wait!  Love their salads!
Best burger in Austin hands down! 2 wonderful locations, local brew. Hopdoddy is pretty much a weekly venture for my and my crew.
best crafted burger hands down. worth the wait!
Amazing burgers, get a Fireman's 4 or a milkshake and you're good to go.
If you can stand the line, one of the best places to have a burger.  Personally, the line is a little too much, but they do take orders outside.  Try it. 3 stars for the line.
If you like things like rare beers and good food, then go here.

This place has the second most delicious burger I have ever eaten in my life.  At first I thought it was just an expensive gimmicky burger joint but after tasting their food I was converted.   I highly suggest you carve out a good amount of time to visit this place so you can enjoy the burger at a leisurely pace.  Their milkshakes are good too, but as with any milkshake watch out for the calories (they are best shared!!!)
Burgers were amazing. Service was awesome while waiting in line, people were very friendly.

Best burgers in town, hands down.  The ahi tuna burger is unmatched, unless you consider every other burger on the menu.  The chocolate shakes are unbeatable as well.  Welcome to burger heaven in Austin, TX
Tuna heaven.

I love the burgers but I don't love the set up of the restaurant. You feel as if you are being herded through like cows.  Not a great place to hang out and drink and relax, but a great place to go if you want the best burger and a quick meal.

Don't be too intimidated by the line that wraps around the building. It's only there because HopDoddy's is awesome! The line goes quick, the food is great and so are there drinks and shakes! Try the nutella pretzel milk shake while you wait in line. You can't go wrong with any of HopDoddy's organic burgers and don't forget to ask for a side of sassy sauce for your fries!
So delicious, get the mushroom burger!
Hopdoddy's is my favorite burger joint!  I love everything about this location.  My favorite burger is the Ahi Tuna burger - very delicious and divine!
Great atmosphere, very nice staff, and the burger was delicious!
Great burgers. Usually a line so expect to wait at least 30min. Great drinks too. I would recommend parking across the street behind homeslice and walking.
Had it today.

Hopoddy is probably one of the best burger joint in town. They also have a location on Anderson Lane. Everything is really good. When you order, make sure to add a fried egg on top.   For dessert, DO NOT forget to try out one of their shakes Be prepare to run about 10 miles to burn the calories from that shake.
I love their burgers! best place in Austin to get burgers. Also they have hysterical T-Shirts.
Wanna burger go here. They have all natural organic food. The burgers are always well cooked and seasoned and the bar has a full selection of beer. The line may seem long but moves quickly.

I'm only 36, but their atmosphere made me feel old. It was like waiting on the sidewalk to get into a club. Menu had no prices, which I thought was presumptuous. You're invested in a 20 minute wait before you can order and get the prices. The food was expensive for what you get. Lots of hype. Lamb patty on hamburger was tepid and quite pink and glossy in the center. Fries were okay.  Cut the prices by 30%, fix the workflow (lines) issues, and ditch the pretentious hipster atmosphere, and this location has a shot of surviving at least three years in this location. Otherwise, gl;hf.
Try the Greek, it's the best lamb burger in Austin.
I love these Burgers! Always fresh. They keep is clean, and that is very important to me!
Always delicious, especially the Llano Poblano. Never disappoints.
This is hands down some of the greatest burgers ever made. Every single burger on the menu is amazing! Hopdoddy's should  make more restuarants in austin because its getting very popular.
The atmosphere here is great and they have a phenomenal chocolate shake! Don't leave town with out trying one!

Fresh buns, veggie fixings, and the most tender and juicy beef patty ever.  Each burger is a special concoction of gourmet cheese, sauce, and spices.  Try the Prime Time, if you like brie and caramelized onions!
I've had better burger and better burger experiences. It gets too crowded and I hate how you can't eat comfortable because everyone is line watches you eat.
Terralingua

would you care for a drop deadly burger or shake, or beerita, OR FRIES??!!?!?! one time i wanted all these things so bad i walked to hopdoddy from west campus -in the summer- and i made it and i would walk again.

An upscale burger joint with craft beers is not necessarily innovative, but it'll make for a satisfying experience. Comfort food, done in a exciting way, with beer in a vibrant way. It works with anyone you're with, especially out of town visitors.
Hopdoddy's! This place is sick. Eat here!
This is the best burger I've had in Austin. Contentious as that may be, I'm hard pressed to budge on this. Delicious burgers, delicious fries, great staff!
really is one of the best burgers placed ive been too! lots of different types of burgers, and they provide a healthy selection
Hopdoddy, if you can get around the line, is the best place for a burger in Austin. Delicious.
Great burgers and good beer selection!  The line can be a bummer but in the end it is definitely worth it.
Best burgers in Austin! Their shakes are amazing as well, especially the Carmel and Sea Salt. Also love the local beers and sodas :)
Food was just so good!

Just: Great. One of the first places I ate at in Austin, and it continues to be one of my favorites. The Bison Burger was, well, incomparable. Folks that complain about the line, need to understand that that's part of the charm. Wait with friends, think about the food, then order a cold beer and enjoy!
best burgers in austin, and affordable prices
I must say, Hopdoddy has the best hamburgers in Austin!!!

This place is very simple but very good. These mouth watering burgers are delicious even has a vegetarian option for those that don't like beef. It leave you feeling good and not heavy with a organic patty! a MUST GO
I'm addicted to the food.  Everything from the milkshakes to the fries and of course the burgers are awesome.  No matter what you order you can't go wrong.
HopDoddy is fine, but it's not my in my top 5 burger places in Austin.  That being said, they do have a lot of unique options and ordering process, plus I love their natural sodas.

My favorite burger in Austin and maybe ever! I don't know what they do, but their patties are so juicy and flavorful atop those house-made buns.  Every one I've tried, which is nearly every menu item, it excellent--even the salad.  The have daily specials that have never disappointed as well.  My friend and I have started to make a habit of ordering one special and one off menu, cutting them in half to share so we can have the best of both.  The milkshakes are pretty tasty as well, but I don't indulge in those too often.  It's a must visit place for out of towners.
Ahi tuna burger is amazing
Best burgers in Austin! Definitely try the Llano Poblano during hatch green chile season for a great spicy burger.

hopdoddys is an incredible place to eat. the food is grown locally which is great for the local economy and additionally bread is baked at the business. if you want a good quality, healthy burger hopdoddy's is the place to be.
Great Burgers, long lines are worth it!  Get there early and stay late for the drinks and sports on the tube.
Delicious lamb burger. Delicious Ahi tuna burger. Delicious burgers in general. Decent beer selection. Divine salted caramel shake. Go fat kid on one and worry about dieting later.
The bomb!!!

I love this place. It serves all natural meat, locally sources produce, and is yummy! The prices are fair as well. However, there is usually a long wait. I got a blue cheese burger, with a bun made in house. It was excellent. Oh I also forgot, they make their own ice cream. I rarely get shakes but that won me over. SOOO worth the calories!

Hopdoddy is a cool burger joint with a bar.  I ordered the ahi tuna burger and it was fantastic! Burgers don't come with fries, but it's worth it to splurge for fries and a drink.  Go if you are just wanting a burger and a good beer.

This is my most favorite place for a burger in Austin. I love everything about this place. The way you have to wait in line like you're trying to get into a hot nightclub. How you can order drinks as you wait in line at the bar. Their burgers, milkshakes and even the fries. I would go there every week if I thought my body wouldn't implode. 5 stars all the way.
There is no comparison. PERIOD. Their Ritas are amazing!!!!
I was told it would be the best hamburger I would ever eat. They were right. Un. Be. Lievable. I had the Shroom burger - grilled mushrooms and melted goat cheese. I will never forget it.
Best hamburger and fries I've ever had! Definitely a busy place though so plan on waiting in line. It is worth the wait!

The Buffalo Bill.  My standby.  Just a hint of sweetness in their buns (hee!).  They play with all sorts of curious things to make their burgers, from the ahi tuna to veggie varieties that even I found tasty.  Try and sit at the bar, so you can sip a shake and skip the line.

The best burger I've ever tasted for a great price. Their shakes are creative and taste amazing! The line often extends out the door, but it typically moves very quickly and is well worth it for the quality of food.
WHY DO OTHER BURGER PLACES EXIST?! HOPDODDY IS THE BEST EVER.
I love this place. They use all natural beef and organic veggies, and they also bake their own bread. you can't go wrong!
Best hamburger place ever. Fries and Milkshakes awesome too. Lines are always really long though. Overall though it is excellent
Gets incredibly crowded but that is what happens when you have the best burgers and shakes in town.  Tip: roll in before 11:45 and you might get to skip the line.

I love this restaurant. They have by far the best veggie burgers I've ever had. Best of all, you can sub the veggie patty on any of the various styles of burgers available. I love my spicy food so I usually get the El Diablo with a veggie patty. When you get the burger, be sure to grab some truffle fries too, they're equally amazing.  My only complaint is the extremely long wait. It regularly takes 30 minutes to an hour of just standing in line outside. But to make that even worse, when you finally get inside, your line just continues until you finally order and get seated.
Based on the reviews I thought it would be amazing but my wife and I were pretty underwhelmed. We tried 3 different burgers and felt they were bland. Truffle fries were good, but I've had better...
The best Grass-fed Angus Burger I have ever taste. Worth the upgrade price. The Margarita's are Awesome.

Ahi Tuna Burger. UNBELIEVABLE. best burger I've ever had. Feeling a little guilty that it's not beef.   El Diablo. Had a few bites. Also delicious.   Chili Cheese Fries. Seriously what the heck. AMAZING.   Chocolate Pretzel Shake. The Best. Shake. Ever.   And then? We didn't have to wait in line again when we wanted to add stuff to our order, like, you know....more shakes. :)

Like the North Austin location, this place has fantastic burgers, including natural beef, bison, and veggie varieties, and a huge combination of excellent toppings and sauces. All in all one of the best burger places in town. They also have great milkshakes, and a fully stocked bar for happy hour drinks.  This location is also about as popular, with notably long lines during the noon hour and from 6:30-8 or so. Expect to spend some time waiting if you show up at those times.

Best burger in Austin. Hands down. It's a bit on the premium side for pricing but the ingredients are fresh and local and the combinations to choose from will make your mouth water just waiting in line.
Awesome gluten free bun. The food is great and the drinks tasty. Would highly reccomend this place.

Austinites are willing to stand in line. Some folks wonder if that's worth it. More often than not, the answer is no. But at Hopdoddy, the answer is almost certainly yes. Outstanding burgers and toppings, stellar fries, and a bar featuring inventive cocktails and plenty of local beers.

If you want a great burger go here. Lots of options and a perfectly cooked burger. The concept is great and a fun experience. You can grab a beer while waiting in line which makes it a much nicer waiting time.
Hopdoddy is the best burger I have ever had and the service is excellent! The environment is also awesome!

The line SUCKS, wahh wahh, had to say it. However, my veggie burger was amazing & it even reheated well when I ate the second half for lunch the next day. Truffle fries are a must! The service was so-so, I think they are too busy for their own good at times. I'd go again, but I'll wait for the hype to die down a bit or until I'm with out-of-towners wanting to give it a try.
LOVE THIS PLACE!!! best burgers
One of our top 3 burger joints in Austin.  Be sure to try the Turkey / Veggie burger.  The fries are awesome, too.  Haven't yet tried the milkshakes, but hear they are great.

I LOVE Hopdoddy's!  It is my favorite place in Austin to get a veggie burger!  My husband loves the buffalo burger the best for those of you that like meat :) Go early if you don't want to wait in line-- it is worth the wait!

Hopdoddy's was fantastic! The atmossphere was really modern and chic and the staff were super friendly. We went just around noon, and we didn't have much of a wait at all. They have burgers for everyone, even vegetarians and people who don't like beef. Also their milkshakes are to die for. If you don't mind waiting a bit, then it's really worth it!
If your in Austin visiting and wants some great food and ambiance stop in. Great food and service!
Probably my favorite gourmet burger place in town. Every single item on the menu is delicious and the beer is served in giant chalices.

Oh Hopdoddy, you would be so great if you weren't always so crowded. It's really, REALLY good but not a place you can go to often because there is ALWAYS a wait. I've loved every burger I've ever had there, but again, it's crowded and cramped and I don't ever know if I am allowed to review my own drink.

If you can't decide whether to get Sushi or a Buger, go get HopDoddy's Ahi Tuna Buger. The tuna is amazing, the wasabi honey is to die for, and the line is worth the wait because the bar is intelligently placed halfway between the wait.   It's just a shame that I can't find an Ahi Tuna Burger anywhere else anywhere near as good as I find them at Hopdoddy's, because that means I have to make my weekly pilgrimage just for that one burger. Sushi or burgers? Get both!

They take a simple dish, like a hamburger, and make it decadently delicious. Top grade beef, tuna and chicken. Fresh and local vegetables. Milkshakes that are addictive (Girlscout cookie thin mint milkshake...what!) Even the fries are made with sea salt, parsley (and maybe shallots?) Simple with a twist. It's more expensive than other burger places, but it's worth it. I would gladly pay premium for everything they have to offer.
A pricey, but fun and good tasting stop when you are craving original Austin burgers.

Everytime we have friends come over, we do tend to bring them to SoCo. This is one of the best burgers I had, especially the ahi tuna. Medium rare and with a wasabi based sauce, it was to die for. However you have to brave the usually long lines and have to wait 30 minutes. But it's definitely worth it. Also you can park at the parking garage for 2 hours for free with the ticket validated here.
Really fun restaurant. Never have I wanted to order everything off the menu at one time like I did here. Each burger sounds incredible andthe one I choose (Primetime) was fantastic.
The service was great and fast. The burgers tasted great. The shakes were really good.
Sweet, sweet, sweet burgers and beer! One of the best burgers I have ever had :9

The Omnivore's Dilemma talks about how pretty much everything that makes it to your plate is made of corn.   HFCs, corn fed beef, and ethanol are all a part of how food gets to your plate, but not at Hopdoddy.  Corn is a dirty word here.  Anyway,  eat here if you'd like to know what corn free food tastes like.  Hint: it's awesome.
I love this fancy burger joint.  The buffalo bill with blue cheese and bacon and their caramel and sea salt milkshake are my favorites.  I love their unique flavor combinations.

Best TRENDY/GOURMET burger in Austin, in my opinion.  If you are looking for a classic American (greasy) burger you can save a few bucks and go to The Crown and Anchor or P Terry's.  But if you are in the mood for a delicious, gourmet and likely ten dollar burger - this is the place!

I'll be brutally honest. This place is NOT worth the wait. I'll allow you to reflect on my experience:  I like to eat LARGE portions, satisfying ones, when I go out for good-old-junk food that goes straight to your fat deposits. This place is so caught up in being hip and trendy with their "progressive minded" burgers that they forget to fill up your plate. If you are looking for a "fancy" burger where maybe half of your mouth will have enough food so it can salivate, then by all means eat here. BUT if you want the greasy goodness to overwhelm your senses and leave you in a post-burger-hour-long-delight then don't bother here.   Do you like to stand in line for 40-60 minutes before a meal? If yes, then this is the right place for you. Along with it's progressive burgers, they've go the latest, trendiest diet down, how to lose weight by standing in line. This is not the place to go for those with lower body issues, especially relating to the knees, ankles, feet, thighs: need I go on? Expect to stand in line and starve before you get your over-priced "sexy" portion that will make you look OH SO TRENDY!  Do you enjoy people staring at you while you are devouring food? Hop Daddy's creates a unique atmosphere where the seating is delightfully crammed and the 50 people in line stand directly across the length of the restaurant, so when you at last get a table you can be sure you'll be the centerpiece of attention, as hungry and curious eyes direct themselves to you, the WHOLE time. It's truly an ideal place for those who love basking in attention. You can be sure to brag about how the whole city saw you hanging out at hop daddy's. SO cool, oh my!  The food does taste good, but if you ask me I think this is a PERFECT example of an overrated restaurant that most people obsess over because EVERYONE is talking about it. Please, try it once and see for yourself how much it's glory is exaggerated.
first time to go and i loved it!!! best burgers I've had in a while
I get the magic shroom burger every time I usually get a live oak as well.
Hopdoddy's is great! The food is fantastic as is the service! Their teringua burger is delish!
One of the best burgers in Austin! Has parking behind it on SoCo, but I recommend going at an off-time since the line can be around the block.
The Burgers where cooked to perfection. The fast & friendly service gives it a comfortable atmosphere. I would highly reccomend this place to any tourist.
Hopdoddy's is never a disappointment I LOVE this place, their food, atmosphere and everything in between

Hopdaddy has shaken my in n' out is king belief to the core.  love the classic burger with bacon (no cheese) plus green chili queso fries.  perfection.  the line is daunting, but moves quickly.  brave through this, and you'll be rewarded.
This is  an exciting place to eat your favorite burger. It has a unique and at the same time superb taste for me. The drinks were also pretty good.

Favorite place to get a burger. I get cravings for it in the middle of the night and most likely will make the trip to satisfy that craving. There is almost always a line out the door and down the street, I've found that the secret is to go around off times (about 3pm) for a short wait. But either way, it's always a great experience. Worth the wait!
Definitely amazing burgers and fries. Just prepare for a wait and realize that you're going to pay for quality. Seriously the best burger bar in Austin.

Hopdoddy's runs an efficient operation. While the line is always long it moves quickly and once you order you're automatically assigned a seat. The line also goes right past the full service bar, which always checks in with the line to help ya out. Once the order's in it's game on as the food is amazing. I don't know if they offer takeout boxes because I doubt anyone has ever left food on his/her plate. Their burgers are perfectly cooked and delicious! They pay attention to every aspect with home made buns, local vegetables, and enhanced ketchup/mustards. The Kobe burger is my favorite as the patty just can't be beaten. Make sure you check out where your food came from while in the line - it's great to see them supporting local business. Great place on a great street, can't wait for the one coming up north near Burnet!
Nice options for Burgers. Once of the best burger in Austin.
Hopdoddy has excellent service. If there is a mess up on an order, they are more than happy to accomodate. Their hamburgers are the best in town!
Best burgers in Austin by far
"Packed, and with good reason. Excellent burgers + superb fries + lots of drinks = long lines. Fortunately, the line moves fast!"
Best burgers in Austin! Best homeade bread! From the burgers, to the fries, to the shakes i give it all 5 stars.

Hopdoddy's is delicious!  Great burger variety- good sized burgers too.  My husband and I can usually share one with a side of fries (of course).  The truffle fries are great too.  And for dessert....milkshakes- nutella/pretzel one is fabulous!

Hopdoddy's is part of Austin's killer elite when it comes to burgers.  There are two champions in Austin right now...and Hopdoddy's is one.  The bison is off the chain good and the fries are madhouse.  Only draw backs are that they don't have enough seats in the place...and that's cause the place is huge already...I think we may have to find a warehouse somewhere to house the droves of people that line up for that Hopdoddy's flavor...oh look at the time...think I need me some Hopdoddy's for dinner.

When you see a line that forms around a building it is usually a good sign as far as food goes.  That is the case at Hopdoddy - absolutely amazing place.  Circle Blur on tap, great shakes, and awesome burgers.
The burgers and shakes are awesome. There is always a long line so try not to go when you are extremely hungry. I think they are worth the wait!
Llano poblano burger is the best! Also, salted caramel shake and thin fries, yum!
A bit pricey, bit really really good. Everything from the chipotle ketchup to the unique seating style was great. A bot hipsterish and a bit pretentious, but let the food speak for itself
Amazing Magic Shroom burger!!!!!

The best burger I've ever had in my entire life. Everything about it is perfect, well made and tastes like everything you've ever wanted in a burger. The milkshakes are also bomb. My favorite is the Goodnight burger, but everything on the menu is top notch.

The food was great, but the wait was so, so long. It felt like waiting to get into a concert (the line wrapped around the building). But the service was good and the food was well worth the wait, if you're super hungry. I loved their parmesan fries!
Great burgers and good beer selection.  The fries were really good also
Great place, really worth the wait!
Amazing food and service.  Visited Austin for 4 days and ate here twice! Llano Pablano is out of this world.
Excellent burgers as long as you aren't in a hurry. The line was so long it took us about an hour to get our food but if you can afford the wait, the food is worth it.

As over rated as one can get in Austin. Besides the lines that wrap around the corner of the building, the patties taste bland and are not on par with other burger joints in the area (looking at you Casino El Camino). Although it is very well polished aesthetically, coupled with a great looking crowd, the burgers are a major disappointment for the price level and cult following.
The burgers are great and the drinks especially the Nutella Pretzle Shake!
I love the concept.  Homemade burgers and beer.  The food is always great and the servers are nice to be around.  Just be prepared for a long line depending on when you go
Get a farm egg with your burger. Best burgers in Austin!!
Good food, good drink, good ice cream.
The hamburgers were big and juicy. The parmesean fries were delicious and the nutella and chocolate pretzel shake was definetly worth the price.

It really is hard to beat their burgers!  I've been here a few times.  It can seem a bit...chaotic...but just follow the signs and directions of the overly helpful staff.  You'll have a great burger experience and will want to come back for more!!  Be sure to "upgrade" to free range beef!
I had heard a lot about Hopdoddy and I finally went today. It was a great experience and I would recommend it to my friends. Everything tasted amazing!!
Not the best burger in Austin, but damn good - especially if you're not the biggest beef eater. Loved the bar scene as you wait in line - nice touch.

Hop Doddy on South Congress has one of the coolest atmospheres. Hopdoddy also promotes a menu that is all natural. WIth on bite of the food you can tell that the quality of food is amazing. The burger meat is not your traditional burger meat it fresh delicious and amazing! At hopdoddy for all your non-meat eaters they also boast a menu with Turkey burgers and vegetable burgers.
Tried the special with onion marmalade, magic shroom, and buffalo bill.   Buffalo bill was three stars, but the two other burgers get 5 stars.
Amaze

Excellent Excellent Excellent that wasnt a typo either. Try the Return of the Mac burger! Fries are out of this world as well not to mention the custom condiments and Terrific service, just plan on waiting in line, forgot to mention the good drinks and easy to navigate menu. That is all.

It's always a little crowded, but they manage the lines really well. We got water while standing in line, and the line moves pretty quickly. The food is delicious, and the parmesan/garlic fries are the best ever.

Such great burgers!  The fries weren't as great as people led me to believe they would be, but the herbs they add to them make them a bit more edible.  But the burgers, are delicious and there are so many creative variations of the burger.  You dont even have to stick with plain old ground beef, as they have other options like bison, lamb, tuna, turkey, and hemp veggie.    I just wish they would take phone orders, as its not a practical place to go to lunch during the workday, since I have to drive across town, wait in a 10 minute line to place an order, then wait 12 minutes for the food to be ready.

The burger is...fine. Its just fine. Not amazing. Not the best ever. Just fine. The service is pretty non existent. The ambiance is great, the waiting definitely makes you really anticipate your meal. But really, you add in the ridiculous wait time, the fairly proud pricing and the burgers that are 'just fine' and well, I'm one less person you have to worry about keeping the line long.

Best burger I've ever tasted!! There was a long line when I got there, but the service was so great that it didn't feel like I wasted any time standing in line. It's a great place for dinner if you're in the South Congress area!

HopDoddy always has a ridiculous line, and after trying it one night, we realized this was for a good reason. We were lucky enough to have a rude group in front of us and made friends with the hostess while complaining about them. She then told us that two seats were open at the bar where food could still be ordered with a much shorter wait. Definitely try this if possible as the line to order was much longer and we probably saved over 30 minutes.  The beer was very good and went well with the spicy burger. The bartender / waitress knew a lot about the beer choices as well as the menu and made good suggestions. She was also very friendly with us and earned her tip for sure. She even went as far as to recommend what beer would pair with which burger. We also bonded over complaining about the F1 crowd (we chose to forget to mention we were part of it).   The burger was excellent, one of the best I've had and the choices of sauces and toppings were very good. The price was also not bad for how much food we got.   It was definitely worth the wait for such a good burger and good beer.
For unique burgers, this is the place to go in Austin!

There's a reason the line reaches around the corner night in and night out- fresh angus beef embraced by perfectly toasted buns and fix ins to your hearts delight! Great place to catch a casual meal and in a great location to take a late night stroll after dinner.

The wait can be unbearable almost any night of the week, but the food is absolutely superb. If you don't like long lines, opt to go during off hours. The food is worth it. The salmon burger is making my mouth water just thinking about it!
Not as good as all the hype. However if you are in the mood for a huge burger, it does not disappoint. Bring your appetite and an open mind.

Hopdoddy's burgers are the best. The meat is very juicy and tender, and their spicy ketchup is amazing. Their fries are perfectly seasoned, and just the right thickness. If you like spicy, their spicy burger is the best! And their milkshakes are amazing!
Love their burgers. The Greek is an burgasm in my mouth

Hopdoddy is an exciting place to eat and drink. The bar offers custom drinks. The burgers are unique, delicious and made with fresh ingredients. There is often a long line outside but it tends to move fairly rapidly

OMG, yes the burgers are amazing but to me the real winner is the french fries!! I've had the lamb, a classic style and a few of their special burgers and they have all been excellent. Their house made dipping sauces are awesome.
Love their burgers and their cocktails!
Only downside is the wait!

From the guys who brought you Moonshine, Eddie V's, and Z Tejas comes beer (hop) & burgers (doddy)! How can you go wrong with that combo? Everything on the menu is delicious, but what really excited me about this place was the maine root. root beer, mexi-cola, and Dublin Dr. Pepper. Yum!
The secret to a non-soggy bottom bun:    Flip it over and cut that business in half.    Bam.
Delicious food. There is usually a wait but it's worth it! I've not had a bad meal here...perfect for a group date night or out of towners. I'm still dreaming about that caramel sea salt milkshake...
It's pricy, but the burgers are great -- they even have a kobe option if you're feeling fancy. Fries and shakes are also great, and they have good, inventive sauces for dipping.
Burger is one of the best in town...but careful not to go when it's crazy busy because you will meet "the line".
One of the best burgers in Austin if you want something unique and different. I'd recommend the salted caramel milkshake. The burgers are delish!

Hopdoddy has the best burgers in Austin hands down.  My personal favorite is the Llano Poblano.  They grill the poblano peppers to perfection.  It fits perfectly in the burger.  Their queso and fries is also beyond words.  You could easily get that as your meal.  Although I haven't tried it, my vegan friends swear by the veggie burger.  They say it is the best vegan burger in Austin.  This place is worth the long lines.  Your stomach will thank you later.
Fabulous burgers!!  You may have to wait in line, but it is worth it.

I have a love hate relationship with this place. The menu is fantastic but the staff (at least FOH) seems lazy and poorly managed. I think a lot of people realize this but are willing to overlook it because the food is so good. I really wish they'd run the tabs more like a bar. I'd love to be able to open a tab at the bar while I wait in line, and then order my food on the same tab in the kitchen; when I'm ready to leave the servers can just bring me my bill, and if people forget to pay their bills, just tack on an automatic 20% tip like everybody else does. It boggles my mind that they haven't already thought of this, and is also the reason I think that, while the service is "ok" at best, the real problem is poor management.  They have a great location, great food, great atmosphere, great drinks, but the service and management is why this place, to me, will always be "good" and not "great".
Best Burgers in Austin, hands down
Sweet homemade burgers, all local ingredients. Always fresh. Great beer and wine selections and awesome atmosphere. Well worth the long waits on the weekend.
If you get the Ahi Tuna burger, you will not regret it. Also, if you park in the parking garage behind Hopdoddy's, they will validate your parking ticket.
Awesome burgers!! This is a great place to go with friends, a great local hot spot.
One of the better burgers in Austin. Don't worry about the line, it's actually part of the attraction. You can get a very cold beer while you wait.
SO GOOD! i had the lamb burger, fries and chocolate milk shake. all delicious. i plan on going back soon to try some of the other burgers.

I always get the "special" and I'm never disappointed.  My wife always get the same burger... and she's never disappointed either :)  Plus, rotating beer taps and drink specials.  I'd give you a tip on how to get a seat earlier, but that may hinder my ability.  I'm just not that nice... :)
By far best burgers in Texas, we drive all the way from San Antonio to just eat there. Shakes are amazing to along with the cervezaritas!
Great burgers. They have gluten free buns for the burgers (especially check out the burger specials). My husband says they have a great beer selection.
Seasalt Caramel milkshake will melt your face off. And you will like it.   Best place in Austin. Kerby Lane is overrated, GO TO HOPDODDY
LOOOVE this place. Delicious burgers, full bar, great service.

You haven't been to Hopdoddy yet? Is it because of the insane, Disneyland-like lines? Don't fret: it's worth it. One of the best burgers I've had... ever. Delicious, fresh beef, always cooked well, with delicious egg buns (gluten free option, too!) that are made daily. Just go. Your stomach will thank you.
The Best Hanburger Ive ever eaten, it was about a 20 min wait, but I think you will feel it was well worth the wait.Just a plain burger for my first experience. Wow!!!
GREAT GREAT FOOD!!! A little pricey for a college student. But excellent food, beer and service!!!
Be sure to get the caramel sea salt shake!

I got there at a not too busy time of day, which is always a plus. The milkshakes are to die for and the burgers are the most interesting and tasty combos I've experienced in a while. Definitely a place to at least try once.
The burgers here are some of the most flavorful burgers I've ever tasted. The bun is especially delicious. I recommend the Tuna Burger
Hopdoddy is the best burger in Austin.  Reasonably priced drinks. Starting at 6-7 bucks a burger. Free parking garage in back.

I have to say that my first visit to Hopdoddy failed to meet my expectations; and in fact, if it wasn't for the outstanding service, I would vow to never return.   The food was adequate, but nothing to write home about.  My first mistake was ordering the least expensive burger on the menu which is called, "The Classic Burger" along with the Kennebec Fries and a Classic Frozen Margarita.   The burger was pretty basic although the patty was Angus beef; and the meat was juicy and freshly prepared.  I did like the sauce on the burger, but it seemed to be a mixture of ketchup and mayo. Nothing really special about that, but it was pleasant.    The Kennebec Fries were another disappointment; and they arrived at my table slightly cold and completely unappealing.  The fries are cut to an almost matchstick size and were sprinkled with a somewhat tasty something or other and topped with tiny sprigs of what I think was parsley.  Most of them were so small and appeared to be the ends of the "real" fries that I had to use a fork to pick them up.  Sadly, some of them were forever lost, drowned in the chipotle ketchup.   The margarita was another failure because while the menu promised that they are made with fresh citrus juices and triple sec, the thing tasted like it was made from bottled sweet and sour mix.  Ugh!
Love this place. Just get there early as it does get crowded.

A burger is just a burger, unless it's Hopdoddy!  I want to try every burger, but each time I go I have to try the monthly special.  We take all of our out-of-town visitors here, and they all love it.  Just a warning, the line will be out the door by 6pm on any given night, but it moves quickly.  Don't hesitate to jump in line.
Pricy but good. Be prepared to wait. Shakes are better than burgers in my opinion. Parking garage.
first time there, great food and the best service!!! thanks carmen!!
Wait in line for beef, Almost not worth it, but then... Put it in your mouth.  Go on an off hour or day, don't wait an hour for a really great burger. It's not worth it. But maybe 20 minutes is.
Went for lunch on a monday. Arrived before 12 and had no wait--wait was out the door by 12:40 when we left.  I got the primetime burger but subbed the beef for Ahi: HOLY SWEET MOSES.   Great food.

I wondered why everytime I walked in front of this place, it was packed and the lines were long.  It was not until some months later when I had extra time in my hands and decided to give it a try.  very cool place, very laid back, lines are long all right, but it moves fast.  You can also buy drinks from the beginning of the line, so that makes your waiting more bearable.  The burgers are so great, not only in selection and ingredients, but also in flavor.  I will definetely  go back here

This place is pretty decent.  I was surprised at how busy it was for a Monday afternoon (around 230pm), but... whatever, I was taking the food to go.  The seating I don't really get- when I entered, a girl handed me a number and asked how many were in my party, because I'd be seated at "43". I told her it was just me, and it was to go- so she took the tag with 43 back and said "tell them it's to go when you order".  Ok. That was my plan.  I still don't know where or what 43 is.  I was now 75. I waited around for a bit, but forgot to check the time when I began the wait.  It didn't take all that long... Maybe 10 minutes? I should have stayed and eaten there. On the way home my food got cold, which is my own fault.... But I could tell the fries would be better hot.  As they usually are. I got the Janis Joplin (the veggie option), and it's pretty good.  It's different than what most places give you.  It's loaded and heaping and isn't just a patty with some indistinguishable somethings chopped up into it.  If I hadn't looked at other reviews on here, I'd never have known it was a hemp patty.  (I didn't pay a lot of attention to the menu... just chose "vegetarian".)  The reason for the 3 stars however is....  2 stars for the delicious sauces, and potentially more for the delicious sounding drinks and milkshakes (I'll add those if they're worth it after another trip). 1 star for trying to give something a little more exciting than the same ole in a veggie burger. No stars for the patty itself being pretty bland... All the flavors I'm getting are the avacado, sprouts and tomato added.  Add a little chipotle ketsup and it's a bit better... It's good, but I don't know if I'll get it again.  I can't say how the meat burgers are, and I never will.... But as a vegetarian, this place is "A-OK". Edit Remove

I'll be honest--I feel like a blasphemer for not giving Hopdoddy 5 stars. The food is just... indescribably good. The restaurant clearly cares about the product they put on the table, and it's reflected in the taste. The tasty, tasty taste. I'm sure any choice on the menu is a good choice, but I can personally recommend The Goodnight and The Magic Shroom. And the truffle fries... Let's just say that if I had to choose one thing to eat exclusively for the rest of my life, Hopdoddy truffle fries would be it. But here's the thing--I CANNOT justify waiting an hour and a half for a burger! I guess it's a testament to the deliciousness of the restaurant. It's run efficiently, there's plenty of dining space on the inside, and the food comes quickly. I think there are just that many people clamoring to get their hands on that tasty burger. But then you think, "Well, there's another location on Anderson--surely it's not the same out there!" No such luck, compadre. So here's my tip for eating at Hopdoddy: prepare. Have a snack. Bring a bottle of water. You're in for the long-haul, and there's no way around that. There is an outside line, and there is an inside line--inside line means beer can be procured. Once you accept that, you won't hit internal rage mode quite as quickly when you see that snaking line around the building. You will get through this, and you will be rewarded--trust. Good, beefy things covered in cheese and truffle oil come to those who wait.
